content.comment_body: Hello everyone. I have a [product_name] with article number [article_no] and firmware version [version_no]. Can it support Modbus?

That's incorrect. [product_name] devices with article number [article_no] and firmware version [version_no] or higher support Modbus TCP. The first and second generation models had the same article number, which caused confusion. They are differentiated by FS status and firmware version.
